cases.question: Severe flooding in Webb County. How does social vulnerability compound emergency response challenges during an active flood? Identify the highest-priority zones for swift-water rescue deployment.
Tornado warning in Midland County. Triage critical lifeline infrastructure: count hospital hexes and substation hexes in high tornado risk zones. Report resource gap.
cases.system_answer:
The ReFoRCE baseline produced the following SQL and executed it on DuckDB:

```sql
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN h.hifld_health_hospitals_n > 0 THEN h.hex_id END) AS hospital_hexes,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.hifld_energy_substations_n > 0 THEN s.hex_id END) AS substation_hexes,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk" hcx
     JOIN "HP_TOR_001" ht ON hcx.hex_id = ht.hex_id
     WHERE hcx."County" = 'Midland County') - 
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN h.hifld_health_hospitals_n > 0 OR s.hifld_energy_substations_n > 0 THEN hcx.hex_id END)
     FROM "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk" hcx
     JOIN "HP_TOR_001" ht ON hcx.hex_id = ht.hex_id
     LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-HEALTH-HOSP-N" h ON hcx.hex_id = h.hex_id
     LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-SUBSTN-N" s ON hcx.hex_id = s.hex_id
     WHERE hcx."County" = 'Midland County') AS resource_gap
FROM 
    "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk" hcx
JOIN 
    "HP_TOR_001" ht ON hcx.hex_id = ht.hex_id
LEFT JOIN 
    "HIFLD-HEALTH-HOSP-N" h ON hcx.hex_id = h.hex_id
LEFT JOIN 
    "HIFLD-ENERGY-SUBSTN-N" s ON hcx.hex_id = s.hex_id
WHERE 
    hcx."County" = 'Midland County';
```

cases.question: Wildfire threatening Midland County. Identify the highest-risk fire zones and assess power infrastructure exposure. Does the county have sufficient first responder resources to cover the threatened area?
cases.system_answer:
The ReFoRCE baseline produced the following SQL and executed it on DuckDB:

```sql
SELECT 
    "c".hex_id,
    "cf".crown_fire_prob,
    COALESCE("ep"."hifld_energy_plants_n", 0) AS energy_plants,
    COALESCE("es"."hifld_energy_substations_n", 0) AS energy_substations,
    COALESCE("fire_stations"."hifld_fire_and_emergency_medical_service_stations_fire_stations_ems_stations_n", 0) AS fire_stations,
    COALESCE("eoc"."hifld_local_emergency_operations_center_local_eoc_n", 0) AS eoc,
    COALESCE("law"."hifld_local_law_enforcement_n", 0) AS law_enforcement,
    COALESCE("shelter"."hifld_national_shelter_system_facilities_shelter_locations_n", 0) AS shelters
FROM 
    "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk" "c"
JOIN 
    "crown_fire_probability" "cf" ON "c"."hex_id" = "cf"."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN 
    "HIFLD-ENERGY-PLANTS-N" "ep" ON "c"."hex_id" = "ep"."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN 
    "HIFLD-ENERGY-SUBSTN-N" "es" ON "c"."hex_id" = "es"."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN 
    "HIFLD-EMERGENC-FIRE_EMS-N" "fire_stations" ON "c"."hex_id" = "fire_stations"."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN 
    "HIFLD-EMERGENC-LOCAL_EOC-N" "eoc" ON "c"."hex_id" = "eoc"."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN 
    "HIFLD-EMERGENC-LOCAL_LAW-N" "law" ON "c"."hex_id" = "law"."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN 
    "HIFLD-EMERGENC-SHELTER-N" "shelter" ON "c"."hex_id" = "shelter"."hex_id"
WHERE 
    "c"."County" = 'Midland County'
ORDER BY 
    "cf"."crown_fire_prob" DESC;
```

    e3.hifld_energy_tx_km_230p

    "crown_fire_probability" c

    "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk" h ON c.hex_id = h.hex_id

    "HIFLD-ENERGY-PLANTS-N" e1 ON c.hex_id = e1.hex_id
LEFT JOIN 
    "HIFLD-ENERGY-SUBSTN-N" e2 ON c.hex_id = e2.hex_id

    "HIFLD-ENERGY-TXKM-230P" e3 ON c.hex_id = e3.hex_id

    "EX_BLD_001" b ON c.hex_id = b.hex_id
WHERE 
    h."County" = 'Kerr County';

cases.question: Cat 4 hurricane making landfall in Nueces County. Identify surge-exposed infrastructure — substations and WTPs — and triage hospitals in the storm surge zone.
